clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz keeps a dwarven siege engine ready for battle. Known as “Fizzer,” he belongs to the Ironforge Siege Brigade and tends Jetsteam.

At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz keeps Jetsteam ready for battle. The depot lies just outside Ironforge, where he tends the heavy war machine he pilots. He tunes its parts and gathers what it needs for the field. Fellow driver Pilot Stonegear joins him in talk of vehicle designs, armor plating, and engine output. Their work keeps the mountain kingdom's mechanized strength ready across Khaz Modan.
